use default

walk(dir: string) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[string] is
    for path in IO.Directory.get_files(dir) do
        yield path
    od

    for sub in IO.Directory.get_directories(dir) do
        yield in walk(sub)
    od
si

let root = "walk-sample"

IO.Directory.create_directory("{root}/sub/deeper")

for (name, dir) in [
    ("a.txt", root),
    ("b.log", root),
    ("c.txt", "{root}/sub"),
    ("d.txt", "{root}/sub/deeper")
] do
    IO.File.write_all_text("{dir}/{name}", "")
od

walk(root)
    |> filter(path => path.ends_with(".txt"))
    |> sort()
    |> each(path => write_line(path))

IO.Directory.delete(root, true)
